title: Feeling Discouraged? God Will Help You Keep Going | Isaiah 50:7
description:
Feeling discouraged? What does it mean to keep following God when the way becomes difficult?

Isaiah 50:7 gives us a powerful picture of steadfast faith:

“Because the Lord GOD helps Me, I have not been disgraced; therefore I have set My face like flint, and I know that I will not be put to shame.”

In this short Christian devotional reflection, we consider what it means to remain faithful to God when obedience becomes difficult—when we face opposition, rejection, suffering, or uncertainty.

Setting your face like flint isn't about becoming hard toward people or simply pushing through by your own strength. It is about keeping your face toward God and remaining faithful because the Lord GOD is your help.

You may not know what lies ahead. You may not be able to control the outcome. But you can trust the One who helps you.

Then, let Scripture move from reflection into song with a word-for-word Scripture song based on Isaiah 50:7.

A short reflection. Scripture. A song. A moment to pause and draw near to God.

title: Isaiah 40:31 - But Those Who Wait
description:
In Isaiah 40:31, we are reminded that those who wait on the Lord will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles, run and not grow weary, and walk and not faint.

What if God is using the waiting to strengthen you?

Waiting on God doesn't mean sitting still and doing nothing. It means trusting that He is at work even when we cannot see what He is doing.

You may feel weak while you're waiting, but God is not wasting the waiting. He can use this season to exchange your weakness for His strength and teach you to keep walking with Him.

If you're waiting on God today, don't mistake the waiting for weakness. Keep trusting. Keep holding on. His strength will be enough.

title: 2 Chronicles 7:14 | What if God isn't asking you to fix what's broken?
description:
What if God isn't asking you to fix what's broken... but inviting you to come closer to Him?

In 2 Chronicles 7:14, God gives His people a pathway toward restoration: humble themselves, pray, seek His face, and turn back to Him. The promise is powerful — He hears, He forgives, and He heals.

Sometimes we're so focused on asking God to change what's around us that we miss what He is inviting us to do within us.

So, today... don't carry the burden of fixing everything. Instead, bring it to God and trust Him with everything.

title: Isaiah 41:13 | What Does It Mean That God Holds Your Hand?
description:
What does it mean that God holds your hand?


In Isaiah 41:13, God gives us a beautiful picture of His presence:


“For I am the LORD your God,
Who takes hold of your right hand
And tells you,
Do not fear.
I will help you.”


What does it mean to know that God is the One who takes hold of your hand? In this short reflection, we pause to consider the comfort, nearness, and help found in this promise—and what it means when we face moments of fear and uncertainty.


Then, let Scripture move from reflection into song with a Scripture song based on Isaiah 41:13.


A short reflection. Scripture. A song. A moment to pause and draw near to God.
